heading: Sorted by hand in Karachi.
intro: ReUnion 31 sources branded secondhand clothing, sorts it by category and brand, and sells it in bundles to resellers and vintage stores in the US, UK and Europe.
body:
We started selling wholesale on Fleek, where we have completed more than 200 orders and built a group of repeat buyers.

Every piece is checked by hand before it is packed. We keep categories separate, so a fleece bundle is all fleece and a knitwear bundle is all knitwear, and we tell you the condition up front.

If you want to see your bundle before you pay, ask. We send real photos or a video of the exact pieces.

values.title: Honest grading
values.text: Condition is noted on every quote. No surprises when the box arrives.

values.title: Category-pure bundles
values.text: You buy only the categories your store sells.

values.title: Video handpick
values.text: Ask for a video of your bundle before it ships.
